minor.issue: PATCH request with body {"force_password_reset": false} returns 400 {"detail":"Nothing to update."} — the field is not a recognised patchable attribute on the user schema. Workaround: use POST /api/rbac/users/{uid}/reset-password with {"force_reset": false} which works correctly. Consider adding force_password_reset to the PATCH allow-list for admin convenience.

Transition payload field is `note` (singular) not `notes` — the review_request spec used `notes`. If the FE ever sends `notes` (plural) it will silently be dropped by Pydantic and the engine will 400 with 'requires a note'. Consider aliasing both or documenting explicitly.

rca of the issue: Bug A root cause was Storyline slide surface using `items-center py-16`, which vertically centred content taller than viewport — pushing the top (bucket badge) off-screen. Fix: `items-start pt-14 pb-28` + inner `<div className='w-full my-auto'>` so short slides still centre visually via margin-auto while tall slides scroll from the top with the bucket badge always in-view. Bug B root cause was that CAO's role_id was pointing to a role without tournaments.create permission; Iter 117-119 fix in AuthContext.isOfficeBearer (derived from persona.role_id) + hon_treasurer role gaining tournaments.create/edit/publish/close + seed_roles_and_permissions refreshing on drift resolved it. Verified working after clearing force_password_reset (which was blocking navigation to /tournaments).
